Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
Bradley of Adelaide wrote:
> Basicly what i want to do is a deck around the following Combination
>
> Burst of Sunlight
> Rotschreck
> Amaranth

Won't work, as mentioned elsethread. Rotschreck causes a vamp to go to
torpor _after_ combat ends.

> Now first of all is This possible. Secondly will this combo beat the
> Combat ends, Dodge cards.

It will beat S:CE and dodge (and all other strikes, since the Rotschreck
keeps the strikes from resolving). It gets beaten by Psyche! and
Telepathic Tracking.

Also note that you can only play Rotschreck when it's not your turn
(because it's an Out of Turn Master), so you'd have to block somebody or
be rushed, and you can only play one Rotschreck per turn (because it's a
Master).

--Colin McGuigan

> For the combo to get even better, add inscription :) Inscription with
> burst of sunlight will be a permanent rotschreck monster since you
> don't have to burrn the burst/inscription to play the Rotschrek :)

Yes, you do. You have to burn the Inscription in order to use the Burst
of Sunlight card to declare your strike as "Burst of Sunlight", which
must be done in order to satisfy the requirements of Rötschreck.
